name: understand-anything
description: Pointer to Understand-Anything (Egonex-AI, MIT) — a multi-agent pipeline that turns a codebase into an interactive knowledge graph with guided tours, semantic search, diff-impact analysis, and an onboarding dashboard. Its analysis core is a TypeScript + native tree-sitter build, so it is installed upstream rather than re-homed into this markdown marketplace (same posture as not re-homing claude-mem's runtime). This entry documents what it does, when to reach for it vs. graphify / github-repo-analyzer, and the one-line install. A full native vendor is a follow-up decision (DR-011).
